verdict.rationale: Gladia documents code switching on its default model across 100+ languages (gladia-docs-15). It also documents transcribing audio that switches languages (gladia-docs-12), which implies the service identifies which language is spoken per segment. However, that same doc tells you to use an explicit language list, and no evidence shows the language can be detected with no declaration at all. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic language detection with no language parameter, detected-language output field, async vs live detection behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
